good.default: This step improves future possibilities. Goal can be achieved in { score } steps.
good.goal: This step enables reaching the goal. Goal can be achieved in { score } steps.

neutral.default: This step does not change future potential. Goal can be achieved in { score } steps.
neutral.no_goal: This step does not change future potential.

feedback.bad: This step reduces future possibilities or makes the proof more complicated.

hints.idle: Make a step or add a justification to receive feedback.

newstep.creating: Choose the justification for the new step.
newstep.assumption: Fill the assumption formula and confirm.
newstep.axiom: Select the input steps from the proof, fill in schema variables or type the formula manually and confirm.
newstep.rule: Select the input steps from the proof and confirm.

newjust.axiom: Enter axiom schema name and formula and confirm.
newjust.rule: Enter rule name, inputs (if any) and output formula and confirm.
